title: correctedLocation
responsibility: Resolves helper names and entity categories at the viewed revision; omits helper owners only when their callable name is unambiguous.

inputs.name: correctedLocation.at
inputs.description: The address that was asked for.

inputs.name: correctedLocation.entities
inputs.description: The entities of the shown revision, each with the category its manifest declares there.

inputs.name: compactHelperLocation.at
inputs.description: A resolved callable location to shorten without losing its identity.

inputs.name: compactHelperLocation.entities
inputs.description: Public entities of the target revision.

outputs.name: correctedLocation
outputs.description: Corrected category or the sole helper owner at the selected revision; null when unchanged, unknown or ambiguous.

outputs.name: compactHelperLocation
outputs.description: Owner-free helper location only when one matching owner is proven; otherwise the original location.
